description: List Laviya tasks of a project (projectID, or project by name or task prefix) or of every project you can access; by default the open tasks assigned to you, highest priority first, 25 per page. Filter by status (open, all or status names), search and task type. Returns items (taskID, customTaskID, title, status, priority, complexity, estimatedEffort in minutes, project, parentTaskID, taskTypeID, sprints unless lite), totalCount and hasMore. Read-only. To work through tasks the user selects, pass their taskIDs to laviya_start_delivery_run once, then start and complete each task.

assignedTo.description: me (default): tasks assigned to you or with an open checklist item of yours. anyone: every task of the projects.

lite.description: true leaves the sprints (folders) of each task out.

pageSize.description: Default 25, max 100 (one page fits one laviya_start_delivery_run).

project.description: Project name, part of it, or task prefix (e.g. LVY) instead of projectID. It must match exactly one of your projects.

projectID.description: Laviya project (see laviya_list_projects). Omit both projectID and project to list every project you can access.

search.description: Part of the task title or task code (e.g. LVY-113).

status.description: open (default: all but Ready for deploy (Processed), Test - Verify (ToBeVerified), Verified, Rejected, Completed and Cancelled type statuses), all, or comma-separated status names of the project (e.g. "Backlog, In Progress").

taskTypeIDs.description: Only these task types: 0 Task, 10 Bug, 20 ChangeRequest, 30 Improvement, 40 Debt, 50 Suggestion, 60 Meeting, 70 Story, 80 Epic.

items.description: 0 Task, 10 Bug, 20 ChangeRequest, 30 Improvement, 40 Debt, 50 Suggestion, 60 Meeting, 70 Story, 80 Epic. Default 0.

name: laviya_list_tasks
title: List Tasks
